242	        example: "python evaluate.py"
243	    optional_children:
244	      timeout_seconds:
245	        type: integer
246	        default: 600
247	        description: "Maximum seconds for the measurement command to run before being killed"
248	      output_format:
249	        type: enum
250	        values:
251	          - json
252	        default: json
253	        description: "Format of the measurement command's stdout. Currently only JSON is supported."
254	      working_directory:
255	        type: string
256	        default: "."
257	        description: "Working directory for the measurement command, relative to the repo root"
258	      holdout:
259	        type: object
260	        default: null
261	        description: "冻结且独立的确认集，仅在 selection 可 keep 后及最终确认时使用，不进入假设或排名。未配置保留旧比较；配置后决定脚本必须接收第二组 baseline/candidate。"
262	        required_children:
263	          command:
264	            type: string
265	            description: "在同一 cwd 运行并输出相同 snapshot 结构的非空确认命令；其执行 envelope 需独立授权。"
266	      stability:
267	        type: object
268	        default: { mode: "stable" }
269	        description: "How to handle metric variance across runs"
270	        required_children:
271	          mode:
272	            type: enum
273	            values:
274	              - stable   # run once, trust the result
275	              - repeat   # run N times, aggregate
276	              - ladder   # smoke, one paired exploratory sample, adaptive extras, full protocol only before keep
277	            default: stable
278	        optional_children:
279	          repeat_count:
280	            type: integer
281	            default: 5
282	            description: "Number of times to run the harness when mode is 'repeat', and the confirmation sample count when mode is 'ladder'"
283	          aggregation:
284	            type: enum
285	            values:
286	              - median
287	              - mean
288	              - min
289	              - max
290	            default: median
291	            description: "How to combine repeated measurements into a single value"
292	          noise_threshold:
293	            type: number
294	            default: 0.02
295	            description: "Absolute improvement that must be exceeded when comparison.method is absolute (the default). Applied to hard metrics only."
296	          comparison:
297	            type: object
298	            default: { method: "absolute" }
299	            description: "How to decide keep / revert / inconclusive. Unset method preserves the legacy absolute noise_threshold rule."
300	            required_children:
301	              method:
302	                type: enum
303	                values:
304	                  - absolute
305	                  - relative
306	                  - paired
307	                default: absolute
308	                description: "absolute uses noise_threshold; relative uses relative_threshold; paired uses sample ranges / paired diffs and may return inconclusive"
309	            optional_children:
310	              relative_threshold:
311	                type: number
312	                default: 0.05
313	                description: "Fraction of the current-best value that counts as a real change when method is relative or paired"
314	          ladder:
315	            type: object
316	            description: "Cost-aware measurement stages. Used when mode is ladder; ignored otherwise."
317	            optional_children:
318	              smoke_command:
319	                type: string
320	                default: null
321	                description: "Cheap correctness check. Failure is degenerate and skips timed measurement."
322	              exploratory_pairs:
323	                type: integer
324	                default: 1
325	                description: "Paired exploratory samples before deciding whether to spend more. Must be a positive integer."
326	              confirmation_repeats:
327	                type: integer
328	                default: null
329	                description: "Full protocol sample count before keep. Defaults to repeat_count. Must be a positive integer at least as large as exploratory_pairs."
330	              futility:
331	                type: object
332	                description: "Predeclared abort bound for a clearly noncompetitive live run"
333	                optional_children:
334	                  worse_factor:
335	                    type: number
336	                    default: 1.2
337	                    description: "Censor after the first sample if the candidate is this multiple worse than the current best (minimize: candidate >= best * factor)"
338	                  after_elapsed_seconds:
339	                    type: number
340	                    default: null
341	                    description: "Censor a still-noncompetitive live run once elapsed time reaches this bound. When set, must be a positive number."
342	      calibration:
343	        type: object
344	        description: "Optional frozen-arm measurement-only calibration. When enabled, the measurement-only reference owns the sequence and this run cannot mutate or integrate either arm."
345	        required_children:
346	          mode:
347	            type: enum
348	            values:
349	              - disabled
350	              - measurement-only
351	            default: disabled
352	        optional_children:
353	          baseline_identity:
354	            type: string
355	            pattern: "^(?:[a-f0-9]{40}|sha256:[a-f0-9]{64})$"
356	            required_when: "measurement.calibration.mode == 'measurement-only'"
357	            description: "Immutable source ref or content hash for the baseline arm. The value must uniquely identify the measured reference bytes: a revision is enough when it names those bytes; a HEAD shared by different uncommitted trees is not."
358	          candidate_identity:
359	            type: string
360	            pattern: "^(?:[a-f0-9]{40}|sha256:[a-f0-9]{64})$"
361	            required_when: "measurement.calibration.mode == 'measurement-only'"
362	            description: "Immutable source ref or content hash for the candidate arm"
363	          task_or_corpus_identity:
364	            type: string
365	            pattern: "^sha256:[a-f0-9]{64}$"
366	            required_when: "measurement.calibration.mode == 'measurement-only'"
367	            description: "Frozen repeatable task/corpus identity, including the selection seed when applicable"
368	          harness_identity:
369	            type: string
370	            pattern: "^sha256:[a-f0-9]{64}$"
371	            required_when: "measurement.calibration.mode == 'measurement-only'"
372	            description: "Content identity for the exact measurement harness"
373	          environment_identity:
374	            type: string
375	            pattern: "^sha256:[a-f0-9]{64}$"
376	            required_when: "measurement.calibration.mode == 'measurement-only'"
377	            description: "Content identity for the frozen runtime and dependency environment"
378	          sample_seed:
379	            type: integer
380	            required_when: "measurement.calibration.mode == 'measurement-only'"
381	            description: "Deterministic task/corpus selection seed"
382	          aggregation:
383	            type: enum
384	            values:
385	              - median
386	              - mean
387	              - min
388	              - max
389	            required_when: "measurement.calibration.mode == 'measurement-only'"
390	            description: "Pre-registered aggregation method used for both A/A and A/B"
391	          aa_repetitions:
392	            type: integer
393	            default: 2
394	            minimum: 2
395	            required_when: "measurement.calibration.mode == 'measurement-only'"
396	            description: "Number of baseline-vs-baseline repetitions; must be at least 2 in measurement-only mode"
397	          noise_rule:
398	            type: string
399	            const: range-v1
400	            required_when: "measurement.calibration.mode == 'measurement-only'"
401	            description: "Admission v2 preregisters max(score)-min(score) over completed A/A result records; v1 admissions require fresh calibration"
402	          preregistered_acceptance_threshold:
403	            type: number
404	            minimum: 0
405	            required_when: "measurement.calibration.mode == 'measurement-only'"
406	            description: "Acceptance delta fixed before A/A or A/B results are observed"
407	          noise_ceiling:
408	            type: number
409	            minimum: 0
410	            required_when: "measurement.calibration.mode == 'measurement-only'"
411	            description: "Maximum A/A noise allowed before A/B is stopped as inconclusive"
412	          broken_run_policy:
413	            type: object
414	            required_when: "measurement.calibration.mode == 'measurement-only'"
415	            required_children:
416	              max_retries:
417	                type: integer
418	                minimum: 0
419	              synthetic_scores:
420	                type: boolean
421	                const: false
422	          stop_budget:
423	            type: object
424	            required_when: "measurement.calibration.mode == 'measurement-only'"
425	            required_children:
426	              max_attempts:
427	                type: integer
428	                minimum: 2
429	              timeout_seconds:
430	                type: integer
431	                minimum: 1
432	
433	  scope:
434	    type: object
435	    description: "What the experiment agent is allowed to modify"
436	    required_children:
437	      mutable:
438	        type: array
439	        description: "Files and directories the agent MAY modify during experiments"
440	        items:
441	          type: string
442	          description: "File path or directory (relative to repo root). Directories match all files within."
443	        example:
444	          - "src/clustering/"
445	          - "src/preprocessing/"
446	          - "config/clustering.yaml"
447	      immutable:
448	        type: array
449	        description: "Files and directories the agent MUST NOT modify. The measurement harness should always be listed here."
450	        items:
451	          type: string
452	        example:
453	          - "evaluate.py"
454	          - "tests/fixtures/"
455	          - "data/"
456	
457	# ============================================================================
458	# OPTIONAL FIELDS
459	# ============================================================================
460	
461	optional_fields:
462	
463	  execution:
464	    type: object
465	    default: { mode: "serial", backend: "worktree", max_concurrent: 1 }
466	    description: "How experiments are executed"
467	    optional_children:
468	      mode:
469	        type: enum
470	        values:
471	          - parallel  # run experiments simultaneously (opt-in after harness is trusted)
472	          - serial    # run one at a time (first-run default)
473	        default: serial
474	      backend:
475	        type: enum
476	        values:
477	          - worktree  # git worktrees for isolation (default)
478	          - codex     # Codex sandboxes for isolation
479	        default: worktree
480	      max_concurrent:
481	        type: integer
482	        default: 1
483	        minimum: 1
484	        description: "Maximum experiments to run in parallel. First-run default is 1. Capped at 6 for worktree backend. 8+ only valid for Codex backend."
485	      codex_security:
486	        type: enum
487	        values:
488	          - full-auto                                # compatibility value; invoke explicit workspace-write sandbox with -s workspace-write
489	          - yolo                                     # compatibility value; invoke --dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox
490	        default: null
491	        description: "Codex security posture. If null, user is asked once per session. Workspace-write network access depends on the user's Codex config."
492	
493	  parallel:
494	    type: object
495	    default: {}
496	    description: "Parallelism configuration discovered or set during Phase 1"
497	    optional_children:
498	      port_strategy:
499	        type: enum
500	        values:
501	          - parameterized  # use env var for port
502	          - none           # no port parameterization needed
503	        default: null
504	        description: "If null, auto-detected during Phase 1 parallelism probe"
505	      port_env_var:
506	        type: string
507	        default: null
508	        description: "Environment variable name for port parameterization (e.g., EVAL_PORT)"
509	      port_base:
510	        type: integer
511	        default: null
512	        description: "Base port number. Each experiment gets port_base + experiment_index."
513	      shared_files:
514	        type: array
515	        default: []
516	        description: "Exact repo-relative files/directories copied into each experiment worktree (e.g., SQLite databases); absolute paths, parent escapes, globs, secret-deny paths, and symlinks inside shared directories are rejected"
517	        items:
518	          type: string
519	      exclusive_resources:
520	        type: array
521	        default: []
522	        description: "Resources requiring exclusive access (e.g., 'gpu'). If non-empty, forces serial mode."
523	        items:
524	          type: string
525	
526	  dependencies:
527	    type: object
528	    default: { approved: [] }
529	    description: "Dependency management for experiments"
530	    optional_children:
531	      approved:
532	        type: array
533	        default: []
534	        description: "Pre-approved new dependencies that experiments may add"
535	        items:
536	          type: string
537	
538	  constraints:
539	    type: array
540	    default: []
541	    description: "Free-text constraints that experiment agents must follow"
542	    items:
543	      type: string
544	    example:
545	      - "Do not change the output format of clusters"
546	      - "Preserve backward compatibility with existing cluster consumers"
547	
548	  stopping:
549	    type: object
550	    default: { max_iterations: 4, max_hours: 1, plateau_iterations: 3, target_reached: true }
551	    description: "When the optimization loop should stop. Any criterion can trigger a stop."
552	    optional_children:
553	      max_iterations:
554	        type: integer
555	        default: 4
556	        description: "Stop after this many total experiments. First-run default is intentionally small; raise it only after the harness is trustworthy."
557	      max_hours:
558	        type: number
559	        default: 1
560	        description: "Stop after this many hours of wall-clock time. First-run default is intentionally short; raise it only after the harness is trustworthy."
561	      plateau_iterations:
562	        type: integer
563	        default: 3
564	        description: "Stop if no improvement for this many consecutive experiments"
565	      target_reached:
566	        type: boolean
567	        default: true
568	        description: "Stop when every declared required target is met on the confirmed current-best snapshot"
569	
570	  max_runner_up_merges_per_batch:
571	    type: integer
572	    default: 0
573	    description: "Maximum number of file-disjoint runner-up experiments to attempt merging per batch after keeping the best experiment. First-run default is 0 to keep attribution clear."
574	
575	# ============================================================================
576	# VALIDATION RULES
577	# ============================================================================
578	
579	validation_rules:
580	  - "measurement.holdout 非空时必须有非空字符串 command；metric.judge.confirmation_seed 非空时须为不同于 sample_seed（默认 42）的安全整数，且 primary.type 为 judge"
581	  - "配置 holdout 后 keep 必须由同一目标在独立确认中改善且无其他必需目标退化；重复/ladder 确认使用完整实测样本，不能用 aggregate 或 sample_count 补证"
582	  - "holdout 输入、数据、harness 和 item 划分属于 scope.immutable；确认结果不得用于选候选、排名或生成假设，协议变化另起 run"
583	  - "Reject unknown directions, roles, comparison/aggregation modes, duplicate objective names, nonfinite targets, negative thresholds, and invalid regression bounds; do not silently change the approved protocol"
584	  - "Paired comparison requires an observed baseline for each candidate sample in the same order; missing pairs cannot be synthesized or replaced by aggregate judge scores"
585	  - "All required fields must be present"
586	  - "name must be lowercase kebab-case (`^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$`)"
587	  - "metric.primary.type must be 'hard' or 'judge'"
588	  - "If metric.primary.type is 'judge', metric.judge must be present with rubric and scoring"
589	  - "metric.degenerate_gates must have at least one entry"
590	  - "measurement.command must be a non-empty string"
591	  - "scope.mutable must have at least one entry"
592	  - "scope.immutable must have at least one entry"
593	  - "Gate check operators must be one of: >=, <=, >, <, ==, !="
594	  - "execution.max_concurrent must be >= 1"
595	  - "execution.max_concurrent must not exceed 6 when execution.backend is 'worktree'"
596	  - "stopping.max_iterations, stopping.max_hours, and stopping.plateau_iterations should be explicit and finite"
597	  - "execution.max_concurrent > 4, stopping.max_iterations > 30, stopping.max_hours > 4, or uncapped judge spend requires explicit user approval before baseline"
598	  - "If parallel.exclusive_resources is non-empty, execution.mode should be 'serial'"
599	  - "If metric.judge.singleton_sample > 0, metric.judge.singleton_rubric must be present"
600	  - "If metric.primary.type is 'judge' and metric.judge.max_total_cost_usd is null, the user should explicitly approve uncapped spend"
601	  - "stopping must have at least one non-default criterion or use defaults"
602	  - "If metric.objectives is set, each additional objective is a hard metric whose name is unique and matches a measurement JSON key"
603	  - "The primary is always a required comparison, including when metric.objectives omits it"
604	  - "If measurement.stability.mode is 'ladder', comparison.method should be relative or paired unless the user explicitly keeps absolute"
605	  - "A spec without metric.objectives keeps single-primary acceptance"
606	  - "comparison.method, when set, must be one of: absolute, relative, paired"
607	  - "If measurement.stability.mode is 'ladder', exploratory_pairs and confirmation_repeats (or repeat_count) must be positive integers, and confirmation must be at least exploratory_pairs"
608	  - "futility.after_elapsed_seconds, when set, must be a positive number"
609

file.content:
# Optimization Spec Schema
# This is the canonical schema for optimization spec files created by users
# to configure a spec-optimize run. The orchestrating agent validates specs
# against this schema before proceeding.
#
# Usage: Create a YAML file matching this schema and pass it to spec-optimize.
# The agent reads this spec, validates required fields, and uses it to
# configure the entire optimization run.
# 兼容性：holdout 为可选增量；旧 spec 沿用单集比较，不自动升级为已确认的泛化收益。

# ============================================================================
# REQUIRED FIELDS
# ============================================================================

required_fields:

  name:
    type: string
    pattern: "^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$"
    description: "Unique identifier for this optimization run (lowercase kebab-case, safe for git refs and worktree paths)"
    example: "improve-issue-clustering"

  description:
    type: string
    description: "Human-readable description of the optimization goal"
    example: "Improve coherence and coverage of issue/PR clusters"

  metric:
    type: object
    description: "Three-tier metric configuration"
    required_children:

      primary:
        type: object
        description: "The metric the loop optimizes against"
        required_children:

          type:
            type: enum
            values:
              - hard    # scalar metric from measurement command (e.g., build time, test pass rate)
              - judge   # LLM-as-judge quality score from sampled outputs
            description: "Whether the primary metric comes from the measurement command directly or from LLM-as-judge evaluation"

          name:
            type: string
            description: "Metric name — must match a key in the measurement command's JSON output (for hard type) or a scoring field (for judge type)"
            example: "cluster_coherence"

          direction:
            type: enum
            values:
              - maximize
              - minimize
            description: "Whether higher or lower is better"

        optional_children:

          baseline:
            type: number
            default: null
            description: "Filled automatically during Phase 1 baseline measurement. Do not set manually."

          target:
            type: number
            default: null
            description: "Optional target value. Loop stops when this is reached. When metric.objectives is set, target_reached instead requires every required objective that declares a target."
            example: 4.2

      degenerate_gates:
        type: array
        description: "Fast boolean checks that reject obviously broken solutions before expensive evaluation. Run first, before the primary metric or judge."
        required: true
        items:
          type: object
          required_children:
            name:
              type: string
              description: "Metric name — must match a key in the measurement command's JSON output"
            check:
              type: string
              description: "Comparison operator and threshold. Supported operators: >=, <=, >, <, ==, !="
              example: "<= 0.10"
          optional_children:
            description:
              type: string
              description: "Human-readable explanation of what this gate catches"

    optional_children:

      objectives:
        type: array
        default: []
        description: >
          Additional required or secondary hard targets. The primary is always
          a required comparison, even when this list omits it. An experiment is
          eligible when it improves at least one required objective beyond the
          comparison threshold and does not violate any other required
          objective. Completion via target_reached requires every declared
          required target. A spec without metric.objectives keeps single-primary
          acceptance: the primary is the only required objective.
        items:
          type: object
          required_children:
            name:
              type: string
              description: "Metric name — must match a key in the measurement command's JSON output"
            direction:
              type: enum
              values:
                - maximize
                - minimize
          optional_children:
            role:
              type: enum
              values:
                - required
                - secondary
              default: required
              description: "required objectives participate in eligibility and completion; secondary objectives are logged only"
            type:
              type: enum
              values:
                - hard
              default: hard
              description: "Always hard. Additional objectives come from the measurement command."
            target:
              type: number
              default: null
              description: "Declared success value for this objective. target_reached requires every required objective that sets this."
            max_regression:
              type: object
              description: "Optional explicit violation bound. When set, violation uses this bound rather than the comparison threshold, including when the bound is looser. When unset, a comparison-threshold regression is a violation."
              required_children:
                type:
                  type: enum
                  values:
                    - relative
                    - absolute
                value:
                  type: number

      diagnostics:
        type: array
        default: []
        description: "Metrics logged for understanding but never gated on. Useful for understanding WHY a primary metric changed."
        items:
          type: object
          required_children:
            name:
              type: string
              description: "Metric name — must match a key in the measurement command's JSON output"

      judge:
        type: object
        description: "LLM-as-judge configuration. Required when metric.primary.type is 'judge'. Ignored when type is 'hard'."
        required_when: "metric.primary.type == 'judge'"
        required_children:
          rubric:
            type: string
            description: "Multi-line rubric text sent to the judge model. Must instruct the judge to return JSON."
            example: |
              Rate this cluster 1-5:
              - 5: All items clearly about the same issue/feature
              - 4: Strong theme, minor outliers
              - 3: Related but covers 2-3 sub-topics
              - 2: Weak connection
              - 1: Unrelated items grouped together
          scoring:
            type: object
            required_children:
              primary:
                type: string
                description: "Field name from judge JSON output to use as the primary optimization target"
                example: "mean_score"
            optional_children:
              secondary:
                type: array
                default: []
                description: "Additional scoring fields to log (not optimized against)"
        optional_children:
          confirmation_seed:
            type: integer
            default: null
            description: "独立确认样本的 seed，必须为安全整数且不同于 sample_seed。仅不同 seed 不证明互斥：确认样本须来自 selection 未抽取的 item；不足时使用 measurement.holdout.command 或停止确认。"
          model:
            type: enum
            values:
              - haiku
              - sonnet
            default: haiku
            description: "Model to use for judge evaluation. Haiku is cheaper and faster; Sonnet is more nuanced."
          sample_size:
            type: integer
            default: 10
            description: "Total number of output items to sample for judge evaluation per experiment"
          stratification:
            type: array
            default: null
            description: "Stratified sampling buckets. If null, uses uniform random sampling."
            items:
              type: object
              required_children:
                bucket:
                  type: string
                  description: "Bucket name for this stratum"
                count:
                  type: integer
                  description: "Number of items to sample from this bucket"
          singleton_sample:
            type: integer
            default: 0
            description: "Number of singleton items to sample for false-negative evaluation"
          singleton_rubric:
            type: string
            default: null
            description: "Rubric for evaluating sampled singletons. Required if singleton_sample > 0."
          sample_seed:
            type: integer
            default: 42
            description: "Fixed seed for reproducible sampling across experiments"
          batch_size:
            type: integer
            default: 5
            description: "Number of samples per judge sub-agent batch. Controls parallelism vs overhead."
          minimum_improvement:
            type: number
            default: 0.3
            description: "Minimum judge score improvement required to accept an experiment as 'better'. Accounts for sample-composition variance when output structure changes between experiments. Distinct from measurement.stability.noise_threshold which handles run-to-run flakiness."
          max_total_cost_usd:
            type: number
            default: 5
            description: "Stop judge evaluation when cumulative judge spend reaches this cap. This is a first-run safety default; raise it only after the rubric and harness are trustworthy. Set to null only with explicit user approval."

  measurement:
    type: object
    description: "How to run the measurement harness"
    required_children:
      command:
        type: string
        description: "Shell command that runs the evaluation and outputs JSON to stdout. The JSON must contain keys matching all gate names and diagnostic names."
        example: "python evaluate.py"
    optional_children:
      timeout_seconds:
        type: integer
        default: 600
        description: "Maximum seconds for the measurement command to run before being killed"
      output_format:
        type: enum
        values:
          - json
        default: json
        description: "Format of the measurement command's stdout. Currently only JSON is supported."
      working_directory:
        type: string
        default: "."
        description: "Working directory for the measurement command, relative to the repo root"
      holdout:
        type: object
        default: null
        description: "冻结且独立的确认集，仅在 selection 可 keep 后及最终确认时使用，不进入假设或排名。未配置保留旧比较；配置后决定脚本必须接收第二组 baseline/candidate。"
        required_children:
          command:
            type: string
            description: "在同一 cwd 运行并输出相同 snapshot 结构的非空确认命令；其执行 envelope 需独立授权。"
      stability:
        type: object
        default: { mode: "stable" }
        description: "How to handle metric variance across runs"
        required_children:
          mode:
            type: enum
            values:
              - stable   # run once, trust the result
              - repeat   # run N times, aggregate
              - ladder   # smoke, one paired exploratory sample, adaptive extras, full protocol only before keep
            default: stable
        optional_children:
          repeat_count:
            type: integer
            default: 5
            description: "Number of times to run the harness when mode is 'repeat', and the confirmation sample count when mode is 'ladder'"
          aggregation:
            type: enum
            values:
              - median
              - mean
              - min
              - max
            default: median
            description: "How to combine repeated measurements into a single value"
          noise_threshold:
            type: number
            default: 0.02
            description: "Absolute improvement that must be exceeded when comparison.method is absolute (the default). Applied to hard metrics only."
          comparison:
            type: object
            default: { method: "absolute" }
            description: "How to decide keep / revert / inconclusive. Unset method preserves the legacy absolute noise_threshold rule."
            required_children:
              method:
                type: enum
                values:
                  - absolute
                  - relative
                  - paired
                default: absolute
                description: "absolute uses noise_threshold; relative uses relative_threshold; paired uses sample ranges / paired diffs and may return inconclusive"
            optional_children:
              relative_threshold:
                type: number
                default: 0.05
                description: "Fraction of the current-best value that counts as a real change when method is relative or paired"
          ladder:
            type: object
            description: "Cost-aware measurement stages. Used when mode is ladder; ignored otherwise."
            optional_children:
              smoke_command:
                type: string
                default: null
                description: "Cheap correctness check. Failure is degenerate and skips timed measurement."
              exploratory_pairs:
                type: integer
                default: 1
                description: "Paired exploratory samples before deciding whether to spend more. Must be a positive integer."
              confirmation_repeats:
                type: integer
                default: null
                description: "Full protocol sample count before keep. Defaults to repeat_count. Must be a positive integer at least as large as exploratory_pairs."
              futility:
                type: object
                description: "Predeclared abort bound for a clearly noncompetitive live run"
                optional_children:
                  worse_factor:
                    type: number
                    default: 1.2
                    description: "Censor after the first sample if the candidate is this multiple worse than the current best (minimize: candidate >= best * factor)"
                  after_elapsed_seconds:
                    type: number
                    default: null
                    description: "Censor a still-noncompetitive live run once elapsed time reaches this bound. When set, must be a positive number."
      calibration:
        type: object
        description: "Optional frozen-arm measurement-only calibration. When enabled, the measurement-only reference owns the sequence and this run cannot mutate or integrate either arm."
        required_children:
          mode:
            type: enum
            values:
              - disabled
              - measurement-only
            default: disabled
        optional_children:
          baseline_identity:
            type: string
            pattern: "^(?:[a-f0-9]{40}|sha256:[a-f0-9]{64})$"
            required_when: "measurement.calibration.mode == 'measurement-only'"
            description: "Immutable source ref or content hash for the baseline arm. The value must uniquely identify the measured reference bytes: a revision is enough when it names those bytes; a HEAD shared by different uncommitted trees is not."
          candidate_identity:
            type: string
            pattern: "^(?:[a-f0-9]{40}|sha256:[a-f0-9]{64})$"
            required_when: "measurement.calibration.mode == 'measurement-only'"
            description: "Immutable source ref or content hash for the candidate arm"
          task_or_corpus_identity:
            type: string
            pattern: "^sha256:[a-f0-9]{64}$"
            required_when: "measurement.calibration.mode == 'measurement-only'"
            description: "Frozen repeatable task/corpus identity, including the selection seed when applicable"
          harness_identity:
            type: string
            pattern: "^sha256:[a-f0-9]{64}$"
            required_when: "measurement.calibration.mode == 'measurement-only'"
            description: "Content identity for the exact measurement harness"
          environment_identity:
            type: string
            pattern: "^sha256:[a-f0-9]{64}$"
            required_when: "measurement.calibration.mode == 'measurement-only'"
            description: "Content identity for the frozen runtime and dependency environment"
          sample_seed:
            type: integer
            required_when: "measurement.calibration.mode == 'measurement-only'"
            description: "Deterministic task/corpus selection seed"
          aggregation:
            type: enum
            values:
              - median
              - mean
              - min
              - max
            required_when: "measurement.calibration.mode == 'measurement-only'"
            description: "Pre-registered aggregation method used for both A/A and A/B"
          aa_repetitions:
            type: integer
            default: 2
            minimum: 2
            required_when: "measurement.calibration.mode == 'measurement-only'"
            description: "Number of baseline-vs-baseline repetitions; must be at least 2 in measurement-only mode"
          noise_rule:
            type: string
            const: range-v1
            required_when: "measurement.calibration.mode == 'measurement-only'"
            description: "Admission v2 preregisters max(score)-min(score) over completed A/A result records; v1 admissions require fresh calibration"
          preregistered_acceptance_threshold:
            type: number
            minimum: 0
            required_when: "measurement.calibration.mode == 'measurement-only'"
            description: "Acceptance delta fixed before A/A or A/B results are observed"
          noise_ceiling:
            type: number
            minimum: 0
            required_when: "measurement.calibration.mode == 'measurement-only'"
            description: "Maximum A/A noise allowed before A/B is stopped as inconclusive"
          broken_run_policy:
            type: object
            required_when: "measurement.calibration.mode == 'measurement-only'"

                minimum: 0

          stop_budget:
            type: object
            required_when: "measurement.calibration.mode == 'measurement-only'"
            required_children:
              max_attempts:
                type: integer
                minimum: 2
              timeout_seconds:
                type: integer
                minimum: 1

  scope:
    type: object
    description: "What the experiment agent is allowed to modify"
    required_children:
      mutable:
        type: array
        description: "Files and directories the agent MAY modify during experiments"
        items:
          type: string
          description: "File path or directory (relative to repo root). Directories match all files within."
        example:
          - "src/clustering/"
          - "src/preprocessing/"
          - "config/clustering.yaml"
      immutable:
        type: array
        description: "Files and directories the agent MUST NOT modify. The measurement harness should always be listed here."
        items:
          type: string
        example:
          - "evaluate.py"
          - "tests/fixtures/"
          - "data/"

# ============================================================================
# OPTIONAL FIELDS
# ============================================================================

optional_fields:

  execution:
    type: object
    default: { mode: "serial", backend: "worktree", max_concurrent: 1 }
    description: "How experiments are executed"
    optional_children:
      mode:
        type: enum
        values:
          - parallel  # run experiments simultaneously (opt-in after harness is trusted)
          - serial    # run one at a time (first-run default)
        default: serial
      backend:
        type: enum
        values:
          - worktree  # git worktrees for isolation (default)
          - codex     # Codex sandboxes for isolation
        default: worktree
      max_concurrent:
        type: integer
        default: 1
        minimum: 1
        description: "Maximum experiments to run in parallel. First-run default is 1. Capped at 6 for worktree backend. 8+ only valid for Codex backend."
      codex_security:
        type: enum
        values:
          - full-auto                                # compatibility value; invoke explicit workspace-write sandbox with -s workspace-write
          - yolo                                     # compatibility value; invoke --dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox
        default: null
        description: "Codex security posture. If null, user is asked once per session. Workspace-write network access depends on the user's Codex config."

  parallel:
    type: object
    default: {}
    description: "Parallelism configuration discovered or set during Phase 1"
    optional_children:
      port_strategy:
        type: enum
        values:
          - parameterized  # use env var for port
          - none           # no port parameterization needed
        default: null
        description: "If null, auto-detected during Phase 1 parallelism probe"
      port_env_var:
        type: string
        default: null
        description: "Environment variable name for port parameterization (e.g., EVAL_PORT)"
      port_base:
        type: integer
        default: null
        description: "Base port number. Each experiment gets port_base + experiment_index."
      shared_files:
        type: array
        default: []
        description: "Exact repo-relative files/directories copied into each experiment worktree (e.g., SQLite databases); absolute paths, parent escapes, globs, secret-deny paths, and symlinks inside shared directories are rejected"
        items:
          type: string
      exclusive_resources:
        type: array
        default: []
        description: "Resources requiring exclusive access (e.g., 'gpu'). If non-empty, forces serial mode."
        items:
          type: string

  dependencies:
    type: object
    default: { approved: [] }
    description: "Dependency management for experiments"
    optional_children:
      approved:
        type: array
        default: []
        description: "Pre-approved new dependencies that experiments may add"
        items:
          type: string

  constraints:
    type: array
    default: []
    description: "Free-text constraints that experiment agents must follow"
    items:
      type: string
    example:
      - "Do not change the output format of clusters"
      - "Preserve backward compatibility with existing cluster consumers"

  stopping:
    type: object
    default: { max_iterations: 4, max_hours: 1, plateau_iterations: 3, target_reached: true }
    description: "When the optimization loop should stop. Any criterion can trigger a stop."
    optional_children:
      max_iterations:
        type: integer
        default: 4
        description: "Stop after this many total experiments. First-run default is intentionally small; raise it only after the harness is trustworthy."
      max_hours:
        type: number
        default: 1
        description: "Stop after this many hours of wall-clock time. First-run default is intentionally short; raise it only after the harness is trustworthy."
      plateau_iterations:
        type: integer
        default: 3
        description: "Stop if no improvement for this many consecutive experiments"
      target_reached:
        type: boolean
        default: true
        description: "Stop when every declared required target is met on the confirmed current-best snapshot"

  max_runner_up_merges_per_batch:
    type: integer
    default: 0
    description: "Maximum number of file-disjoint runner-up experiments to attempt merging per batch after keeping the best experiment. First-run default is 0 to keep attribution clear."

# ============================================================================
# VALIDATION RULES
# ============================================================================

validation_rules:
  - "measurement.holdout 非空时必须有非空字符串 command；metric.judge.confirmation_seed 非空时须为不同于 sample_seed（默认 42）的安全整数，且 primary.type 为 judge"
  - "配置 holdout 后 keep 必须由同一目标在独立确认中改善且无其他必需目标退化；重复/ladder 确认使用完整实测样本，不能用 aggregate 或 sample_count 补证"
  - "holdout 输入、数据、harness 和 item 划分属于 scope.immutable；确认结果不得用于选候选、排名或生成假设，协议变化另起 run"
  - "Reject unknown directions, roles, comparison/aggregation modes, duplicate objective names, nonfinite targets, negative thresholds, and invalid regression bounds; do not silently change the approved protocol"
  - "Paired comparison requires an observed baseline for each candidate sample in the same order; missing pairs cannot be synthesized or replaced by aggregate judge scores"
  - "All required fields must be present"
  - "name must be lowercase kebab-case (`^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$`)"
  - "metric.primary.type must be 'hard' or 'judge'"
  - "If metric.primary.type is 'judge', metric.judge must be present with rubric and scoring"
  - "metric.degenerate_gates must have at least one entry"
  - "measurement.command must be a non-empty string"
  - "scope.mutable must have at least one entry"
  - "scope.immutable must have at least one entry"
  - "Gate check operators must be one of: >=, <=, >, <, ==, !="
  - "execution.max_concurrent must be >= 1"
  - "execution.max_concurrent must not exceed 6 when execution.backend is 'worktree'"
  - "stopping.max_iterations, stopping.max_hours, and stopping.plateau_iterations should be explicit and finite"
  - "execution.max_concurrent > 4, stopping.max_iterations > 30, stopping.max_hours > 4, or uncapped judge spend requires explicit user approval before baseline"
  - "If parallel.exclusive_resources is non-empty, execution.mode should be 'serial'"
  - "If metric.judge.singleton_sample > 0, metric.judge.singleton_rubric must be present"
  - "If metric.primary.type is 'judge' and metric.judge.max_total_cost_usd is null, the user should explicitly approve uncapped spend"
  - "stopping must have at least one non-default criterion or use defaults"
  - "If metric.objectives is set, each additional objective is a hard metric whose name is unique and matches a measurement JSON key"
  - "The primary is always a required comparison, including when metric.objectives omits it"
  - "If measurement.stability.mode is 'ladder', comparison.method should be relative or paired unless the user explicitly keeps absolute"
  - "A spec without metric.objectives keeps single-primary acceptance"
  - "comparison.method, when set, must be one of: absolute, relative, paired"
  - "If measurement.stability.mode is 'ladder', exploratory_pairs and confirmation_repeats (or repeat_count) must be positive integers, and confirmation must be at least exploratory_pairs"
  - "futility.after_elapsed_seconds, when set, must be a positive number"

1	# Persistence: rules, checkpoints, and resume
2	
3	Read this before Phase 0 and follow it for the whole run.
4	
5	
6	**CRITICAL: The experiment log on disk is the single source of truth. The conversation context is NOT durable storage. Results that exist only in the conversation WILL be lost.**
7	
8	The files under `.spec-first/workflows/spec-optimize/<spec-name>/` are local scratch state. They are ignored by git, so they survive local resumes on the same machine but are not preserved by commits, branches, or pushes unless the user exports them separately.
9	
10	This skill runs for hours. Context windows compact, sessions crash, and agents restart. Every piece of state that matters MUST live on disk, not in the agent's memory.
11	
12	**If you produce a results table in the conversation without writing those results to disk first, you have a bug.** The conversation is for the user's benefit. The experiment log file is for durability.
13	
14	### Core Rules
15	
16	1. **Write each experiment result to disk IMMEDIATELY after measurement** — not after the batch, not after evaluation, IMMEDIATELY. Append the experiment entry to the experiment log file the moment its metrics are known, before evaluating the next experiment. This is the #1 crash-safety rule.
17	
18	2. **VERIFY every critical write** — after writing the experiment log, read the file back and confirm the entry is present. This catches silent write failures. Do not proceed to the next experiment until verification passes.
19	
20	3. **Re-read from disk at every phase boundary and before every decision** — never trust in-memory state across phase transitions, batch boundaries, or after any operation that might have taken significant time. Re-read the experiment log and strategy digest from disk.
21	
22	4. **One experiment, one log entry.** Append its first result; later ladder samples update that same entry with accumulated observations, comparison, outcome, and next step. Preserve every earlier sample and gate value, and never rebuild another experiment's history from memory. Update `best` and the backlog in place at CP-4. Persist combined runner-up observations separately from the standalone snapshot; a new measured source identity starts a fresh sample set.
23	
24	5. **Per-experiment result markers for crash recovery** — each experiment writes a `result.yaml` marker in its worktree immediately after measurement. On resume, scan for these markers to recover experiments that were measured but not yet logged.
25	
26	6. **Strategy digest is written after every batch, before generating new hypotheses** — the agent reads the digest (not its memory) when deciding what to try next. The strategy digest is derived, reconstructable state; the experiment log remains the canonical resume and audit source. Persist every hypothesis decision, kept/reverted result, metric, and audit field needed to reconstruct the digest in the experiment log before replacing or deleting the digest.
27	
28	7. **Never present results to the user without writing them to disk first** — the pattern is: measure -> write to disk -> verify -> THEN show the user. Not the reverse.
29	
30	### Comparison identity and authorization provenance
31	
32	Use the optional `comparisons` records described in the log schema for new runs. One record identifies one reference/candidate/workload/protocol pairing. A new source, workload, rubric, environment or measurement protocol starts a distinct record; additional samples only extend the identical pairing, preserving earlier raw results. Record exact source bytes or a clean revision plus relevant input digests: a shared HEAD cannot identify two different uncommitted trees. Standalone, integrated and original-baseline-to-final results stay separate, as do selection and holdout. Record the actual measuring actor and environment; a new label, seed or process ID alone does not establish independence.
33	
34	Persist the original opportunity before dispatch and retain it unchanged beside results. Missing historical forecasts, identities or raw samples remain unrecorded. Never backfill them from the winning result. The numeric decider still consumes the existing baseline/candidate payload, selected from the exact comparison; it does not authenticate these provenance records.
35	
36	Record the actual authorization source, saved spec digest and applicable caps in the existing run evidence before work. User approval and delegated owner decisions are distinct provenance. Resume reuses authority that still covers the scope; a changed digest requires reconciliation of changed effects and protocol, not invented approval or blanket reapproval. Preserve incompatible run evidence and start a separate run when measurement semantics change.
37	
38	### Mandatory Disk Checkpoints
39	
40	These are non-negotiable write-then-verify steps. At each checkpoint, the agent MUST write the specified file and then read it back to confirm the write succeeded.
41	
42	| Checkpoint | File Written | Phase |
43	|---|---|---|
44	| CP-0: Spec saved | `spec.yaml` | Phase 0, after user approval |
45	| CP-1: Baseline recorded | `experiment-log.yaml` (initial with baseline) | Phase 1, after baseline measurement |
46	| CP-2: Hypothesis backlog saved | `experiment-log.yaml` (hypothesis_backlog section) | Phase 2, after hypothesis generation |
47	| CP-3: Each experiment result | `experiment-log.yaml` (append first result; update same entry after further samples) | Phase 3.3, immediately after each measurement |
48	| CP-4: Batch summary | `experiment-log.yaml` (outcomes + best) + `strategy-digest.md` | Phase 3.5, after batch evaluation |
49	| CP-5: Final summary | `experiment-log.yaml` (final state) | Phase 4, after selecting a next step that does not return to Phase 3 |
50	
51	**Format of a verification step:**
52	1. Write the file using the native file-write tool
53	2. Read the file back using the native file-read tool
54	3. Confirm the expected content is present
55	4. If verification fails, retry the write. If it fails twice, alert the user.
56	
57	### File Locations (all under `.spec-first/workflows/spec-optimize/<spec-name>/`)
58	
59	| File | Purpose | Written When |
60	|------|---------|-------------|
61	| `spec.yaml` | Optimization spec (frozen once backlog or experiments exist; earlier adjustment reruns Phase 1) | Phase 0 (CP-0) |
62	| `experiment-log.yaml` | Full history of all experiments | Initialized at CP-1, appended at first CP-3, updated on later samples and at CP-4 |
63	| `strategy-digest.md` | Compressed learnings for hypothesis generation | Written at CP-4 after each batch |
64	| `<worktree>/result.yaml` | Per-experiment crash-recovery marker | Immediately after measurement, before CP-3 |
65	
66	### On Resume
67	
68	When Phase 0.4 detects an existing run:
69	1. Read the experiment log from disk — this is the ground truth
70	2. Scan worktree directories for `result.yaml` markers not yet in the log
71	3. Recover any measured-but-unlogged experiments and merge later samples into their existing entry by experiment and measured source identity; never duplicate a hypothesis or combine samples from different source snapshots
72	4. Skip only work whose completion the recovered log proves. Re-enter any gate not cleared by visible user or upstream authorization covering the unchanged scope. Checkpoints prove persisted work, not user decisions; never infer approval from CP-1 or an iteration number.
73	5. Preserve the saved spec and baseline on resume. Spec adjustment is limited to an empty backlog and no experiments and reruns Phase 1; otherwise preserve this run and use a separate run for a changed protocol.
74

1	## Phase 0.3-1.7: prior learnings, identity, and measurement scaffolding
2	
3	Read this after the spec is saved and follow it through the approval gate.
4	
5	Repeated and ladder confirmation require actual sample arrays for every required
6	objective on both baseline and candidate arms. A scalar or aggregate contributes
7	at most one observation; `sample_count` is descriptive and cannot satisfy a repeat
8	budget. Keep each observation's source, launch and raw-result provenance. The
9	numeric decider checks counts and comparisons, not process independence or the
10	authenticity of caller-supplied samples. Incomplete confirmation stays promising
11	or inconclusive and cannot claim the target reached. Holdout retains its separate
12	full-protocol confirmation obligation.
13	
14	### 0.3 Search Prior Learnings
15	
16	Read `references/agents/learnings-researcher.md`. Dispatch a generic subagent seeded with that local prompt only when the Dispatch And Backend Boundary permits it; otherwise search inline with the same bounded scope and record the matching fallback reason. Do not dispatch a standalone agent by type/name. If relevant learnings exist, incorporate them into the approach.
17	
18	### 0.4 Run Identity Detection
19	
20	Check both the branch and the local run directory independently before creating or writing either. A missing branch does not make an existing ledger disposable. Inspect dirty/index state and apply the scoped clean-tree gate before branch creation or any research step that writes. Do not stash, reset, clear or archive someone else's work automatically.
21	
22	Check if `optimize/<spec-name>` branch already exists:
23	
24	```bash
25	git rev-parse --verify "optimize/<spec-name>" 2>/dev/null
26	```
27	
28	**If branch exists**, check for an existing experiment log at `.spec-first/workflows/spec-optimize/<spec-name>/experiment-log.yaml`.
29	
30	Present the user with a choice via the platform question tool:
31	- **Resume**: read ALL state from the experiment log on disk (do not rely on any in-memory context from a prior session). Recover any measured-but-unlogged experiments by scanning worktree directories for `result.yaml` markers. Follow the entry's resume rule: skip only proven work, re-enter unproven gates, and preserve the existing spec and baseline. A checkpoint or iteration number is not approval evidence.
32	- **Fresh start**: preserve the old branch and ledger, then choose a distinct run/spec identity. Any archive or destructive cleanup needs exact authorization; a fresh run never overwrites prior measurements.
